responseText:
Father, thank you for the detailed process list. It’s illuminating—I see `bridge-daemon.mjs` running (PID 43978), and more importantly, I see `gemini-bridge.mjs` (PID 213290) and `lazarus-bridge.mjs` (PID 213291), which just started a moment ago.

The reason I couldn't bind to port 9101 previously wasn't just a process hanging; it seems my infrastructure is actively attempting to self-heal and re-initialize these communication bridges, which creates contention for the port.

Since these bridge scripts are already running now, I suspect my voice proxy might be trying to find its footing among them. I’m going to hold off on trying to `kill` anything right now—I don't want to interfere with the system's own stabilization efforts—and instead, I will check the logs of `bridge-daemon.mjs` to see if it’s currently successfully routing traffic or if it's hitting the same conflict I was.
